title: present simple vs present continuous (review)
rule_uz: Present Simple odat, doimiy holat va jadval haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi: He plays football every Sunday. Present Continuous hozir, aynan shu payt yoki vaqtinchalik davom etayotgan ish uchun ishlatiladi: He is playing football now. Present Continuous am/is/are + fe'l-ing bilan yasaladi. Always, usually, every day kabi so'zlar Present Simple bilan, now, at the moment, today kabi so'zlar Present Continuous bilan keladi.
forms: every day, usually -> Simple; now, at the moment -> Continuous

examples.en: My dad usually drives to work, but today he is taking the bus.
examples.uz: Dadam odatda ishga mashinada boradi, lekin bugun avtobusda ketyapti.

examples.en: Look! The children are playing in the yard.
Our school starts at eight o'clock.

mistakes.wrong: I am go to school every day.
mistakes.right: I go to school every day.
mistakes.note_uz: Odat uchun Present Simple ishlatiladi, am bilan emas.

mistakes.wrong: She watches TV now.
mistakes.right: She is watching TV now.
mistakes.note_uz: Now so'zi bilan Present Continuous kerak.

title: stative verbs (know, like, want, belong)
rule_uz: Ba'zi fe'llar ish-harakatni emas, holatni bildiradi: know, like, love, want, need, belong, understand, believe, prefer. Ularni odatda Continuous zamonda ishlatmaymiz, hatto hozir haqida gapirsak ham. Masalan, "I am knowing" demaymiz, "I know" deymiz. Ba'zi fe'llar (have, think) ma'noga qarab ikkala zamonda ham keladi: I have a bike (egalik) va I am having lunch (ovqatlanish).
forms: I / you / we / they + know / like / want
He / she / it + knows / likes / wants
NOT: am / is / are + knowing / liking / wanting

examples.en: I don't understand this question.
This laptop belongs to my brother.
She wants a new bag for school.
examples.uz: U maktab uchun yangi sumka xohlaydi.

mistakes.wrong: I am wanting an ice cream.
mistakes.right: I want an ice cream.
mistakes.note_uz: Want holat fe'li, Continuous bo'lmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: He is knowing the answer.
mistakes.right: He knows the answer.
mistakes.note_uz: Know Continuous'da ishlatilmaydi.

title: past simple vs past continuous (review)
rule_uz: Past Simple tugagan ish uchun ishlatiladi: I watched a film. Past Continuous o'tmishda biror payt davom etayotgan ish uchun ishlatiladi: At 8 o'clock I was watching a film. Past Continuous was/were + fe'l-ing bilan yasaladi. Ko'pincha uzoq davom etgan ish (Continuous) ustiga qisqa voqea (Simple) kirib keladi: I was watching TV when the phone rang. While bilan odatda Continuous, when bilan qisqa voqea keladi.
forms: I / he / she / it + was + playing

examples.en: I was reading a book when my friend called.
examples.uz: Do'stim qo'ng'iroq qilganda men kitob o'qiyotgan edim.

examples.en: While we were having lunch, it started to rain.
examples.uz: Biz tushlik qilayotganimizda yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.

examples.en: They were playing chess at seven o'clock.
examples.uz: Soat yettida ular shaxmat o'ynashayotgan edi.

mistakes.wrong: I watched TV when she arrived.
mistakes.right: I was watching TV when she arrived.
mistakes.note_uz: Uzoq davom etgan ish Past Continuous'da bo'ladi.

mistakes.wrong: While I walked home, I met Bobur.
mistakes.right: While I was walking home, I met Bobur.
mistakes.note_uz: While bilan odatda Past Continuous keladi.

title: used to
rule_uz: Used to o'tmishda takrorlanib turgan odat yoki endi mavjud bo'lmagan holat haqida gapirish uchun ishlatiladi. Shakli: used to + fe'lning asosiy shakli: I used to play outside. Inkor va savolda did bilan use to yoziladi (d yo'q): I didn't use to like fish. Did you use to live here? Used to faqat o'tmish uchun, hozirgi zamon shakli yo'q.
forms: I / you / he / she / we / they + used to + play
I / you / he ... + didn't use to + play
Did + I / you / he ... + use to + play?

examples.en: I used to be afraid of dogs when I was little.
We used to live in a small village.
Did you use to collect stickers?

mistakes.wrong: I didn't used to like tea.
mistakes.right: I didn't use to like tea.
mistakes.note_uz: Did/didn't dan keyin use to (d siz) yoziladi.

mistakes.wrong: She use to play the piano.
mistakes.right: She used to play the piano.
mistakes.note_uz: Darak gapda used to deb yoziladi.

title: present perfect vs past simple
rule_uz: Present Perfect (have/has + V3) o'tmishdagi ish hozirga aloqador bo'lganda yoki qachon bo'lgani muhim bo'lmaganda ishlatiladi: I have lost my phone (hozir yo'q). Past Simple aniq o'tgan vaqt bilan ishlatiladi: I lost my phone yesterday. Yesterday, last week, in 2020, two days ago kabi so'zlar bilan Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi. Ever, never, just, already, yet, for, since Present Perfect bilan keladi.
forms: yesterday, ago, last year -> Past Simple
ever, never, already, yet -> Present Perfect

examples.en: I have visited Samarkand twice.
We visited Samarkand last summer.
She has just finished her homework.

mistakes.wrong: I have seen him yesterday.
mistakes.right: I saw him yesterday.
mistakes.note_uz: Yesterday bilan Past Simple kerak.

mistakes.wrong: Did you ever eat sushi?
mistakes.right: Have you ever eaten sushi?
mistakes.note_uz: Hayotiy tajriba haqida Present Perfect ishlatiladi.

title: present perfect continuous
rule_uz: Present Perfect Continuous o'tmishda boshlangan va hozir ham davom etayotgan ish haqida, yoki hozirgina tugagan va natijasi ko'rinib turgan ish haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi. Shakli: have/has + been + fe'l-ing: I have been waiting for an hour. For (davomiylik) va since (boshlanish vaqti) bilan tez-tez keladi. How long...? savoli ham shu zamonda beriladi: How long have you been learning English?
forms: I / you / we / they + have been + playing
He / she / it + has been + playing
How long + have / has + subject + been + -ing?

examples.en: I have been studying English for three years.
examples.uz: Men uch yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapman.

examples.en: It has been raining since morning.
Why are you tired? Have you been running?

mistakes.wrong: I am waiting here since two hours.
mistakes.right: I have been waiting here for two hours.
mistakes.note_uz: Davomiylik uchun have been + -ing va for ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: She has been play tennis since 5.
mistakes.right: She has been playing tennis since 5.
mistakes.note_uz: Been dan keyin fe'l -ing shaklida bo'ladi.

title: present perfect continuous vs present perfect simple
rule_uz: Present Perfect Continuous ishning o'zi va davomiyligiga e'tibor beradi: I have been painting all day. Present Perfect Simple esa natijaga yoki necha marta/qancha bo'lganiga e'tibor beradi: I have painted three pictures. Soni yoki natijasi bor bo'lsa Simple, "qancha vaqt" va jarayon bo'lsa Continuous qulay. Stative fe'llar (know, have, like) har doim Simple bo'ladi: I have known him for years.

examples.en: I have been reading all afternoon.
I have read three chapters today.
We have known each other for five years.
examples.uz: Biz bir-birimizni besh yildan beri bilamiz.

mistakes.wrong: I have been knowing her for a year.
mistakes.right: I have known her for a year.
mistakes.note_uz: Know holat fe'li, Continuous bo'lmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: How many books have you been reading this month?
mistakes.right: How many books have you read this month?
mistakes.note_uz: Son so'ralganda Simple ishlatiladi.

title: past perfect simple
rule_uz: Past Perfect o'tmishdagi biror payt yoki voqeadan oldin sodir bo'lgan ishni bildiradi. Shakli: had + V3 (barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil): She had finished before I arrived. Inkori: hadn't + V3. Savol: Had + subject + V3? Ko'pincha before, after, by the time, already, just bilan keladi. Ikki ish haqida gapirganda, avval bo'lgani Past Perfect, keyin bo'lgani Past Simple bo'ladi.
forms: I / you / he / she / we / they + had + finished
avval: had + V3; keyin: Past Simple

examples.en: When I got to the station, the train had already left.
examples.uz: Bekatga yetib borganimda poyezd allaqachon ketib bo'lgan edi.

examples.en: She hadn't eaten breakfast, so she was hungry.
examples.uz: U nonushta qilmagan edi, shuning uchun och edi.

examples.en: Had you seen that film before?

mistakes.wrong: When we arrived, the film already started.
mistakes.right: When we arrived, the film had already started.
mistakes.note_uz: Avval bo'lgan ish had + V3 bilan aytiladi.

mistakes.wrong: He had went home before dinner.
mistakes.right: He had gone home before dinner.
mistakes.note_uz: Had dan keyin V3 (gone) keladi.

title: past perfect vs past simple in stories
rule_uz: Hikoya aytganda voqealarni ketma-ket bo'lgan tartibda Past Simple bilan aytamiz: He opened the door and walked in. Agar biror narsa hikoyadagi asosiy voqeadan oldin bo'lgan bo'lsa, uni Past Perfect bilan aytamiz: He walked in because someone had left the door open. After bilan ikkalasi ham mumkin, lekin Past Perfect "oldin bo'lganini" aniq ko'rsatadi. Bir-biriga ulangan ketma-ket ishlar uchun hamma joyda Past Perfect kerak emas.

examples.en: I was late because I had missed the bus.
examples.uz: Men kechikdim, chunki avtobusdan qolib ketgan edim.

examples.en: After he had eaten, he went out to play.

examples.uz: Yer nam edi. Tun bo'yi yomg'ir yog'gan edi.

mistakes.wrong: He was happy because he won the game.
mistakes.right: He was happy because he had won the game.
mistakes.note_uz: Avval bo'lgan sabab Past Perfect'da aytiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I had opened the door and had come in.
mistakes.right: I opened the door and came in.
mistakes.note_uz: Ketma-ket oddiy ishlar Past Simple'da aytiladi.

title: future forms review (will / going to / present continuous)
rule_uz: Will bilan tez qabul qilingan qaror, va'da va taxmin aytiladi: I'll help you. Going to oldindan rejalashtirilgan niyat yoki hozirgi belgilarga qarab bo'ladigan voqea uchun ishlatiladi: I'm going to learn chess. Present Continuous aniq kelishilgan reja uchun ishlatiladi, odatda vaqti ham aytiladi: I'm meeting Ali at five. Jadval (poyezd, dars) uchun Present Simple ham ishlatiladi.
forms: am / is / are + going to + fe'l (reja, belgi)
Present Simple (jadval): The bus leaves at 6.

examples.en: It's cold. I'll close the window.
Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
I'm playing tennis with Bekzod on Friday at four.
examples.uz: Juma kuni soat to'rtda Bekzod bilan tennis o'ynayman.

mistakes.wrong: Look! That boy will fall off his bike.
mistakes.right: Look! That boy is going to fall off his bike.
mistakes.note_uz: Hozir ko'rinib turgan belgiga qarab going to ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I will meet my teacher tomorrow at nine (we agreed).
mistakes.right: I am meeting my teacher tomorrow at nine.
mistakes.note_uz: Kelishilgan reja uchun Present Continuous yaxshiroq.

title: future time clauses (when, as soon as, before, until + present)
rule_uz: Kelajak haqida gapirsak ham, when, as soon as, before, after, until, while so'zlaridan keyin will ishlatmaymiz. Ularning ichida Present Simple ishlatiladi. Asosiy gapda esa will keladi: I will call you when I arrive (when I will arrive emas). Until "...gacha" degan ma'noni beradi: Wait here until I come back. Agar ish tugaganligini ta'kidlamoqchi bo'lsak, Present Perfect ham mumkin.
forms: when / as soon as + Present Simple, ... will + fe'l
I will call you when I arrive.

examples.en: I will text you as soon as I get home.
examples.uz: Uyga yetib borishim bilan senga yozaman.

examples.en: We'll wait until the rain stops.

mistakes.wrong: When I will see him, I'll tell him.
mistakes.right: When I see him, I'll tell him.
mistakes.note_uz: When dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: I'll stay here until you will come.
mistakes.right: I'll stay here until you come.
mistakes.note_uz: Until dan keyin Present Simple kerak.

title: will vs going to (contrast)
rule_uz: Will va going to ikkalasi ham kelajak uchun, lekin ma'nosi farq qiladi. Gap gapirilayotgan paytda qaror qilsak, will ishlatamiz: Oh, no money! I'll ask my dad. Gapirishdan oldin qaror qilgan bo'lsak, going to ishlatamiz: I'm going to ask my dad tomorrow. Hozirgi belgiga asoslangan bashorat uchun going to, shaxsiy fikr yoki taxmin uchun (I think, probably) will ishlatiladi. Va'da va taklif uchun will keladi.
forms: will: payt-payti bilan qaror, va'da, fikr

examples.en: I haven't got a pen. I'll borrow yours.
examples.uz: Qalamim yo'q ekan. Seniki'ni olib turaman.

examples.en: I'm going to borrow a pen from Ali. I've already asked him.
examples.uz: Alidan qalam olmoqchiman. Uni allaqachon so'raganman.

examples.en: I think our team will win tomorrow.

mistakes.wrong: Look at the sky! It will rain.
mistakes.right: Look at the sky! It is going to rain.
mistakes.note_uz: Ko'rinib turgan belgi bo'lsa going to ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I'm going to help you with that bag. (just decided)
mistakes.right: I'll help you with that bag.
mistakes.note_uz: Shu zahoti qaror qilsak will ishlatiladi.

title: first conditional and unless
rule_uz: Birinchi shart gap kelajakda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan holat va uning natijasi haqida gapiradi. Shakli: If + Present Simple, will + fe'l: If it rains, we will stay at home. If'dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi. Unless "agar ... bo'lmasa" degan ma'noni beradi va if ... not bilan bir xil: Unless you hurry, you will be late = If you don't hurry, you will be late. Unless'dan keyin inkor shakl ishlatilmaydi.

examples.en: If you study hard, you will pass the test.
We will go to the park if the weather is nice.
Unless we leave now, we'll miss the bus.

mistakes.wrong: If it will rain, we will stay home.
mistakes.right: If it rains, we will stay home.
mistakes.note_uz: If dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: Unless you don't hurry, you will be late.
mistakes.right: Unless you hurry, you will be late.
mistakes.note_uz: Unless o'zi inkor ma'noli, yana not kerak emas.

title: second conditional
rule_uz: Ikkinchi shart gap hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy, haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan yoki ehtimoli kam holatlar haqida gapiradi. Shakli: If + Past Simple, would + fe'l: If I had a dog, I would walk it every day. If'dan keyin would ishlatilmaydi. If gapida to be uchun hamma shaxsga were ishlatsa bo'ladi: If I were you, I would study more. Bu shakl maslahat berishda ham ishlatiladi.
forms: If I / he / she / it were ...
If I were you, I would ...

examples.en: If I had a lot of money, I would buy a big house.
examples.uz: Agar ko'p pulim bo'lsa, katta uy sotib olardim.

examples.en: If he were taller, he would play basketball.
examples.uz: Agar u balandroq bo'lganida, basketbol o'ynardi.

examples.en: What would you do if you saw a ghost?

mistakes.wrong: If I would have a car, I would drive to school.
mistakes.right: If I had a car, I would drive to school.
mistakes.note_uz: If gapida would emas, Past Simple ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: If I am you, I would say sorry.
mistakes.right: If I were you, I would say sorry.
mistakes.note_uz: Xayoliy holatda were ishlatiladi.

title: first vs second conditional
title_uz: Birinchi va ikkinchi shart gap farqi
rule_uz: Birinchi shart gap real, bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan holat uchun: If I finish early, I will call you (balki tugataman). Ikkinchi shart gap xayoliy yoki deyarli bo'lmaydigan holat uchun: If I finished early, I would call you (lekin ehtimol tugatmayman). Birinchisida If + Present Simple, will; ikkinchisida If + Past Simple, would ishlatiladi. Gap o'tmishdagi emas, Past Simple faqat shakl, ma'no hozirgi yoki kelajak haqida.
forms: real: If + Present Simple, will + fe'l
xayoliy: If + Past Simple, would + fe'l
If I win (mumkin) / If I won (ehtimol kam)
If I were a bird, I would fly. (mumkin emas)

examples.en: If I find your pen, I will give it to you.
If I found a pot of gold, I would share it with you.
examples.uz: Agar oltin solingan idish topsam, u bilan sen bilan baham ko'rardim.

examples.en: If we have time tomorrow, we will visit the museum.

mistakes.right: If I see him tomorrow, I will tell him.
mistakes.note_uz: Real holatda If + Present Simple, will + fe'l.

mistakes.wrong: If I have wings, I will fly to Paris.
mistakes.right: If I had wings, I would fly to Paris.
mistakes.note_uz: Mumkin bo'lmagan holatda ikkinchi shart gap ishlatiladi.

title: must / have to / need to
rule_uz: Must va have to "kerak, majbur" degan ma'noni beradi. Must odatda gapiruvchining shaxsiy fikri: I must study (men shunday deb hisoblayman). Have to tashqi qoidalar yoki holat sabab: I have to wear a uniform. Need to "kerak, zarur" degan ma'noni bildiradi. Inkorda farq katta: mustn't "mumkin emas, taqiqlangan", don't have to / don't need to esa "shart emas" degani. Have to o'tmishda had to bo'ladi, must'ning o'tmishi yo'q.
forms: mustn't = taqiqlangan; don't have to = shart emas

examples.en: I have to wear a uniform at school.
You mustn't run near the pool.
You don't have to come early. The lesson starts at ten.
examples.uz: Erta kelishing shart emas. Dars o'nda boshlanadi.

mistakes.wrong: You mustn't bring a pen. We have pens here.
mistakes.right: You don't have to bring a pen. We have pens here.
mistakes.note_uz: Shart emas ma'nosi uchun don't have to ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: She must to go to the dentist.
mistakes.right: She has to go to the dentist.
mistakes.note_uz: Must'dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi.

title: can / could / be able to
rule_uz: Can hozirgi qobiliyatni bildiradi: I can swim. Could o'tmishdagi umumiy qobiliyat uchun: When I was six, I could ride a bike. Be able to ham "qila olmoq" degani, lekin barcha zamonlarda ishlatiladi: I will be able to drive next year; I haven't been able to call him. O'tmishda bir marta muvaffaqiyatli bajarilgan aniq ish uchun was/were able to ishlatiladi (could emas): I was able to finish the test yesterday.
forms: am / is / are / was / were / will be able to
will can emas -> will be able to

examples.en: My little brother can already read.
When I was five, I couldn't swim.
After a lot of practice, I was able to play the song.
examples.uz: Ko'p mashq qilgach, qo'shiqni chala oldim.

mistakes.wrong: I will can help you tomorrow.
mistakes.right: I will be able to help you tomorrow.
mistakes.note_uz: Will bilan can emas, be able to ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: Yesterday the firefighters could save the cat.
mistakes.right: Yesterday the firefighters were able to save the cat.
mistakes.note_uz: Bir martalik muvaffaqiyat uchun was/were able to.

title: should / ought to / had better
rule_uz: Should va ought to maslahat berish uchun ishlatiladi: You should drink more water. Ikkalasining ma'nosi deyarli bir xil, faqat ought to dan keyin to keladi. Had better kuchliroq maslahat yoki ogohlantirish: agar qilmasang, yomon narsa bo'lishi mumkin: You had better hurry, or you will miss the bus. Had better'dan keyin to yo'q. Inkori: shouldn't, ought not to, had better not.
forms: ought to / ought not to + fe'l

examples.en: You should go to bed earlier.
We ought to help our grandparents.
You'd better take an umbrella. It's cloudy.

mistakes.wrong: You should to eat more fruit.
mistakes.right: You should eat more fruit.
mistakes.note_uz: Should dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: You had better to leave now.
mistakes.right: You had better leave now.
mistakes.note_uz: Had better dan keyin to yo'q.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: You look tired. You ___ rest.
You ___ eat so many sweets. They are bad for your teeth.
We ought ___ our teacher about the problem.
You had ___ do your homework now, or you won't finish it.
It's very late. You ___ go home now.
I think she ___ say sorry to her friend.

title: deduction: must / can't / might (present)
rule_uz: Biror narsaga ishonchimiz komil bo'lsa, taxmin qilish uchun must, can't va might ishlatamiz. Must "albatta shunday" (deyarli aniq): He must be tired. Can't "bo'lishi mumkin emas" (deyarli aniq inkor): That can't be his bag, it's too big. Might / may / could "balki" (ishonchimiz kam): She might be at home. Hammasidan keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi. Mustn't bu yerda ishlatilmaydi, can't ishlatiladi.

examples.en: Aziz has a lot of homework, so he must be busy.
examples.uz: Azizda uy vazifasi ko'p, demak u band bo'lsa kerak.

examples.en: That can't be Sara. She is in Tashkent.
examples.uz: Bu Sara bo'lishi mumkin emas. U Toshkentda.

examples.en: The lights are off. They might be asleep.
examples.uz: Chiroqlar o'chiq. Ular uxlab qolgan bo'lishi mumkin.

mistakes.wrong: He mustn't be at home. The lights are on.
mistakes.right: He can't be at home. The lights are off.
mistakes.note_uz: Deduksiyada inkor uchun can't ishlatiladi, mustn't emas.

mistakes.wrong: She must to be tired.
mistakes.right: She must be tired.
mistakes.note_uz: Must dan keyin to yo'q.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: She has been running for an hour. She ___ be tired.
It ___ be Jasur at the door. He is on holiday abroad.
I'm not sure, but the shop ___ be open on Sundays.
The baby is crying. He ___ be hungry.
That ___ be true! You are joking.
Where's my phone? It ___ be in my bag, or it could be on the table.

title: passive: present simple
rule_uz: Majhul darajada ishni kim bajarishi muhim emas yoki noma'lum bo'ladi, asosiy narsa ishning o'zi. Present Simple Passive: am / is / are + V3. English is spoken in many countries. Ishni bajaruvchini ko'rsatish kerak bo'lsa, by ishlatiladi: This book is written by a famous author. Inkor: isn't / aren't + V3. Savol: Is / Are + object + V3?
forms: am / is / are + V3 (made, spoken, sold)

examples.en: Rice is grown in warm countries.
Our classroom is cleaned every day.
Are these cakes made at home?

mistakes.wrong: English speaks in many countries.
mistakes.right: English is spoken in many countries.
mistakes.note_uz: Ish sub'ektga qaratilgani uchun is + V3 kerak.

mistakes.wrong: The cars is washed every week.
mistakes.right: The cars are washed every week.
mistakes.note_uz: Ko'plik bo'lgani uchun are kerak.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Milk ___ in the fridge.
Many phones ___ in China.
Football ___ all over the world.
Our school newspaper ___ once a month.
___ the shops closed on Sundays in your town?
The homework ___ by the teacher every Friday.

title: passive: past simple
rule_uz: Past Simple Passive o'tmishda bo'lgan ishni, uni kim bajarganidan ko'ra ishning o'ziga e'tibor qaratib aytish uchun ishlatiladi. Shakli: was / were + V3. The window was broken yesterday. Ko'plikda were ishlatiladi: The windows were broken. Inkor: wasn't / weren't + V3. Savol: Was / Were + object + V3? Bajaruvchini ko'rsatish kerak bo'lsa, by qo'shamiz: The song was written by my uncle.
forms: I / he / she / it + was + V3

examples.en: The museum was built in 1990.
These pictures were painted by children.
Was the window broken by the storm?

mistakes.wrong: The letter was wrote yesterday.
mistakes.right: The letter was written yesterday.
mistakes.note_uz: Was dan keyin V3 (written) kerak.

mistakes.wrong: The cakes was eaten.
mistakes.right: The cakes were eaten.
mistakes.note_uz: Ko'plik bo'lgani uchun were kerak.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The Eiffel Tower ___ in 1889.
My bike ___ last night.
The cookies ___ by my grandmother.
___ you invited to the party last week?
This photo ___ taken by my sister two years ago.
The lights ___ turned off when we arrived, so we couldn't see anything.

title: passive with modals and future
title_uz: Modal va kelasi zamon majhul darajasi
rule_uz: Modal fe'llar bilan majhul daraja: modal + be + V3. The rules must be followed. Homework can be sent online. Kelasi zamonda: will + be + V3: The new park will be opened next year. Going to bilan: is / are going to be + V3. Inkor: mustn't be, can't be, won't be + V3. Bu yerda be o'zgarmaydi, chunki modal fe'ldan keyin doim asosiy shakl keladi.
forms: am / is / are going to be + V3

examples.en: Your phone can be charged here.
The new bridge will be opened next month.
Litter must not be left on the beach.

mistakes.wrong: The room will cleaned tomorrow.
mistakes.right: The room will be cleaned tomorrow.
mistakes.note_uz: Will dan keyin be + V3 kerak.

mistakes.wrong: Rules must followed.
mistakes.right: Rules must be followed.
mistakes.note_uz: Modal + be + V3 shakli ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The tickets can ___ bought online.
The results ___ announced on Monday.
This homework must ___ finished by Friday.
A new shopping centre is going to ___ built in our town.
Old batteries should ___ thrown away in the rubbish bin.
Don't worry about the lost bag. It ___ found soon.

title: reported speech: statements
rule_uz: Birovning gapini boshqaga aytib berganda reported speech ishlatamiz. Odatda said that yoki told him/her that deymiz, that ni tushirib qoldirish ham mumkin. Gap o'tgan zamonda boshlansa, fe'l bir zamon orqaga suriladi: am/is - was, play - played, will - would, can - could. Olmoshlar va payt so'zlari ham o'zgaradi: I - he/she, today - that day, tomorrow - the next day. Told dan keyin odam keladi (told me), said dan keyin kelmaydi.
forms: "I like pizza." - She said (that) she liked pizza.
"I am busy." - He said he was busy.
"I will call you." - She told me she would call me.

examples.en: Ben said, "I have a new phone."  Ben said that he had a new phone.
examples.uz: Ben "Menda yangi telefon bor" dedi. Ben yangi telefoni borligini aytdi.

examples.en: Our teacher said that we could use dictionaries.
Mum told me that she would pick me up at five.
examples.uz: Onam meni soat beshda olib ketishini aytdi.

mistakes.wrong: He said me that he was tired.
mistakes.right: He told me that he was tired.
mistakes.note_uz: Said dan keyin odam kelmaydi, told me deymiz.

mistakes.wrong: She said that she is hungry. (yesterday)
mistakes.right: She said that she was hungry.
mistakes.note_uz: Said o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa, fe'l ham bir zamon orqaga suriladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Tom said, "I am tired." -> Tom said that he ___ tired.
Anna said, "I like cats." -> Anna said that she ___ cats.
The boy told ___ that he was lost.
Sara said, "I will help you." -> Sara said that she ___ help me.
Ali said, "We are playing chess." -> Ali said that they ___ chess.
Dad said, "I have finished my work." -> Dad said that he ___ his work.

title: reported speech: questions
rule_uz: Birovning savolini aytib berganda asked yoki wanted to know ishlatamiz. Savol so'z tartibi oddiy gapga aylanadi: ega fe'ldan oldin keladi, do/does/did kerak emas, savol belgisi qo'yilmaydi. Who, where, why kabi so'roq so'zlar saqlanadi. Ha/yo'q savollarida if yoki whether qo'shamiz. Zamon bir qadam orqaga suriladi: "Do you like tea?" - She asked if I liked tea.
forms: "Where do you live?" - He asked where I lived.
"Are you tired?" - She asked if I was tired.

examples.en: "Why are you late?"  The teacher asked why I was late.
examples.uz: "Nega kech qoldingiz?" O'qituvchi nega kech qolganimni so'radi.

examples.en: My friend asked if I had a bike.
Mum asked me what time the film started.
examples.uz: Onam filmning soat nechada boshlanishini so'radi.

mistakes.wrong: She asked where did I live.
mistakes.right: She asked where I lived.
mistakes.note_uz: Reported savolda do/did ishlatilmaydi, so'z tartibi oddiy gapdagidek.

mistakes.wrong: He asked me do I like tea.
mistakes.right: He asked me if I liked tea.
mistakes.note_uz: Ha/yo'q savolida if yoki whether kerak.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: "Where do you live?" -> He asked me where I ___.
"Are you hungry?" -> She asked me ___ I was hungry.
"What is your name?" -> The man asked what my name ___.
"Do you play football?" -> Tim asked me whether I ___ football.
"Where did you go?" -> Mum asked me where I ___.
"Why is he crying?" -> I asked why he ___.

title: reported commands and requests (tell, ask)
rule_uz: Buyruq yoki iltimosni aytib berganda tell yoki ask + odam + to + fe'l ishlatamiz. Tell buyruq uchun, ask iltimos uchun ko'proq ishlatiladi. Inkor bo'lsa not to qo'yamiz: told me not to run. Bu yerda zamon surilmaydi, chunki to dan keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi.
forms: "Sit down." - He told me to sit down.
"Please help me." - She asked me to help her.
"Don't run!" - Dad told us not to run.

examples.en: The teacher told us to open our books.
I asked my sister to turn off the music.
examples.uz: Men opamdan musiqani o'chirishni iltimos qildim.

examples.en: Mum told Ali not to touch the oven.

mistakes.wrong: She told me close the door.
mistakes.right: She told me to close the door.
mistakes.note_uz: Tell + odam dan keyin to + fe'l keladi.

mistakes.wrong: He asked me don't talk.
mistakes.right: He asked me not to talk.
mistakes.note_uz: Inkorda not to ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: "Be quiet!" -> The teacher told us ___ quiet.
"Please pass the salt." -> She asked me ___ the salt.
"Don't touch it!" -> Dad told me ___ it.
"Please wait here." -> The guide asked us ___ there.
"Do your homework." -> Mum ___ me to do my homework.
"Don't be late, Ali." -> The coach told Ali ___ late.

title: relative clauses: who / which / that
title_uz: Aniqlovchi ergash gap: who / which / that
rule_uz: Relative clause odam yoki narsa haqida qo'shimcha aniq ma'lumot beradi. Odamlar uchun who yoki that, narsa va hayvonlar uchun which yoki that ishlatamiz. Bu so'z gapdagi ega bo'lib kelsa, uni tushirib bo'lmaydi: the girl who lives next door. Who/which dan keyin yana he, she, it qo'shilmaydi. Narsa uchun who ishlatmaymiz.
forms: The man who lives here is a doctor.
The book that I read was great.

examples.en: The boy who sits next to me is very funny.
I have a phone which takes great photos.
examples.uz: Mening ajoyib suratga oladigan telefonim bor.

examples.en: This is the dog that barked at me yesterday.

mistakes.wrong: The girl which sings is my cousin.
mistakes.right: The girl who sings is my cousin.
mistakes.note_uz: Odam uchun who ishlatiladi, which emas.

mistakes.wrong: The man who he lives here is kind.
mistakes.right: The man who lives here is kind.
mistakes.note_uz: Who dan keyin he qo'shilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The woman ___ teaches us English is from London.
I like films ___ make me laugh.
A baker is a person ___ makes bread.
This is the bag ___ I bought in Samarkand.
The students ___ passed the test got a prize.
Look at the robot ___ can dance and sing.

title: relative clauses: where / whose, non-defining basics
title_uz: Where / whose va qo'shimcha izoh gaplar
rule_uz: Where joy haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi: the town where I was born. Whose egalikni bildiradi va odam, hayvon yoki narsa nomidan keyin keladi: a boy whose bike is red. Non-defining clause qo'shimcha, lekin zarur bo'lmagan ma'lumot beradi va vergul bilan ajratiladi: My uncle, who lives in Tashkent, is a pilot. Bunday gaplarda that ishlatilmaydi, faqat who yoki which.
forms: Tashkent, which is big, is my city.
My aunt, who is a nurse, ...

examples.en: This is the park where we play football.
I know a girl whose father is a pilot.
examples.uz: Men otasi uchuvchi bo'lgan bir qizni bilaman.

examples.en: My grandfather, who is seventy, likes fishing.
examples.uz: Bobom yetmish yoshda, baliq ovlashni yaxshi ko'radi.

mistakes.wrong: That is the boy who bike is new.
mistakes.right: That is the boy whose bike is new.
mistakes.note_uz: Egalikni bildirish uchun whose ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: My mother, that is a doctor, works hard.
mistakes.right: My mother, who is a doctor, works hard.
mistakes.note_uz: Vergulli izoh gapda that ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: This is the school ___ I study.
She has a friend ___ brother is a footballer.
Bukhara, ___ is a very old city, is famous for its markets.
I remember the café ___ we first met.
Our neighbour, ___ dog is very big, is very kind.
My brother, ___ plays the guitar, is in a band.

title: articles: a / an / the / no article
rule_uz: A yoki an birinchi marta aytilgan yoki noaniq birlik narsa oldidan keladi: a dog. Unli tovush oldidan an ishlatiladi: an apple, an hour. The ikkala suhbatdosh biladigan yoki yagona narsa oldidan keladi: the sun, the book on the table. Umumiy ma'noda ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar oldida artikl qo'yilmaydi: I like music. Ovqat nomlari, tillar va ko'p mamlakatlar oldida ham artikl yo'q.
forms: the = specific or unique: the moon

examples.en: I saw a film yesterday. The film was funny.
examples.uz: Kecha film ko'rdim. Film kulgili edi.

examples.en: She wants to be an engineer.
Cats are my favourite animals.

mistakes.wrong: I have a umbrella.
mistakes.right: I have an umbrella.
mistakes.note_uz: Unli tovush oldidan an ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I love the pizza. (in general)
mistakes.right: I love pizza.
mistakes.note_uz: Umumiy ma'noda artikl kerak emas.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I have ___ orange in my bag.
She is ___ teacher at my school.
Look at ___ moon! It is so bright tonight.
My dad likes ___ tea.
I would like ___ glass of water, please.
It took us ___ hour to get home.

title: quantifiers (some, any, no, every, all, both, neither)
rule_uz: Some darak gapda, any inkor va savol gaplarda ishlatiladi: I have some books. Do you have any? No "yo'q" ma'nosini beradi va fe'l darak shaklda qoladi: There is no milk. Every + birlik ot: every day. All + ko'plik yoki sanalmaydigan ot: all the students. Both ikki narsa uchun "ikkalasi ham", neither esa "ikkalasi ham emas" ma'nosida; neither bilan fe'l darak shaklda bo'ladi.

examples.en: We have some apples, but we don't have any bananas.
examples.uz: Bizda ozgina olma bor, lekin banan yo'q.

examples.en: Every student has a laptop.
Both my brothers play chess, but neither of them likes football.
examples.uz: Ikkala akam ham shaxmat o'ynaydi, lekin ikkalasi ham futbolni yoqtirmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: I don't have no pens.
mistakes.right: I don't have any pens.
mistakes.note_uz: Inkorda any ishlatiladi, ikki marta inkor bo'lmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: Every students are here.
mistakes.right: Every student is here.
mistakes.note_uz: Every dan keyin birlik ot va birlik fe'l keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: There are ___ eggs in the fridge.
I haven't got ___ money with me.
There is ___ water in the bottle. It is empty.
___ child in our class likes drawing.
I have two cousins. ___ of them live in Khiva.
Tom and Sam are brothers, but ___ of them likes fish.

title: compound pronouns (something, anyone, nobody, everywhere)
rule_uz: Some-, any-, no-, every- so'zlarini -one/-body (odam), -thing (narsa) va -where (joy) bilan qo'shib hosil qilamiz. Something, someone, somewhere darak gapda keladi. Anything, anyone, anywhere inkor va savol gaplarda keladi. Nobody, nothing, nowhere inkor ma'nosini o'zi beradi, shuning uchun fe'l inkor bo'lmaydi. Everyone, everything, everywhere bilan fe'l birlik shaklida turadi.

examples.en: I heard something in the garden.
Nobody knows the answer.
Everyone in our class likes the new teacher.
examples.uz: Sinfimizdagi hamma yangi o'qituvchini yaxshi ko'radi.

mistakes.wrong: I don't know nothing.
mistakes.right: I don't know anything.
mistakes.note_uz: Inkor gapda anything ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: Everyone are happy.
mistakes.right: Everyone is happy.
mistakes.note_uz: Everyone birlik fe'l bilan keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I'm thirsty. I want ___ to drink.
He didn't tell ___ about the surprise.
I can't find my keys ___.
She said ___ and left the room quietly.
It was a secret, so ___ told us about it.
There isn't ___ at home. Let's go to the shop.

title: gerunds and infinitives: verbs followed by -ing or to
rule_uz: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin fe'lning -ing shakli keladi: enjoy, finish, mind, keep, suggest: I enjoy swimming. Boshqalaridan keyin to + fe'l keladi: want, hope, decide, plan, learn, need: I want to go. Like, love, hate, start ikkalasi bilan ham ishlatiladi. Bu qoidani yodlash kerak, chunki har bir fe'l o'z qolipini talab qiladi. Predlogdan keyin ham -ing shakli keladi: good at drawing.
forms: want / decide / hope / plan + to + verb

examples.en: I enjoy reading comics after school.
examples.uz: Men maktabdan keyin komikslar o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman.

examples.en: We decided to visit the zoo on Sunday.
examples.uz: Yakshanba kuni hayvonot bog'iga borishga qaror qildik.

examples.en: She is good at drawing animals.

mistakes.wrong: I enjoy to play chess.
mistakes.right: I enjoy playing chess.
mistakes.note_uz: Enjoy dan keyin -ing shakli keladi.

mistakes.wrong: He wants going home.
mistakes.right: He wants to go home.
mistakes.note_uz: Want dan keyin to + fe'l keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I enjoy ___ football with my friends.
We want ___ a new game tonight.
She finished ___ her homework at six.
My parents decided ___ a new house.
Are you interested in ___ a robot?
He hopes ___ a prize in the competition.

title: stop / remember / try + -ing or to
rule_uz: Ba'zi fe'llar -ing yoki to bilan kelganda ma'nosi o'zgaradi. Stop + -ing: ishni to'xtatish; stop + to: biror ish uchun to'xtash. Remember + -ing: bo'lib o'tgan ishni eslash; remember + to: qilish kerak ishni unutmaslik. Try + -ing: tajriba qilib ko'rish; try + to: urinish, harakat qilish.
forms: stop + to + verb = stop in order to
remember + to + verb = not forget a duty

examples.en: He stopped talking when the teacher came in.
Remember to lock the door tonight.
I tried to open the window, but it was stuck.
examples.uz: Men derazani ochishga urindim, lekin u qotib qolgan edi.

mistakes.wrong: I stopped to eat sweets. (I quit)
mistakes.right: I stopped eating sweets.
mistakes.note_uz: To'xtatish uchun stop + -ing ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: Remember closing the window before you leave.
mistakes.right: Remember to close the window before you leave.
mistakes.note_uz: Keyin qilinadigan ish uchun remember + to.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: It's raining. Please stop ___ so loudly.
Don't forget! Remember ___ your mum tonight.
I remember ___ this song when I was a child.
We were tired, so we stopped ___ a rest.
The soup is too salty. Try ___ some water.
I tried ___ the heavy box, but I couldn't.

title: -ed and -ing adjectives (bored / boring)
rule_uz: Ko'p his-tuyg'u fe'llaridan ikki xil sifat yasaladi. -ed sifat odamning his-tuyg'usini bildiradi: I am bored. -ing sifat his-tuyg'uni keltirib chiqargan narsa yoki odamni tasvirlaydi: the film is boring. Ya'ni men zerikdim - bored, film zerikarli - boring. Boshqa juftliklar: interested - interesting, excited - exciting, tired - tiring, surprised - surprising.

examples.en: I was excited because the trip was exciting.
examples.uz: Sayohat qiziqarli bo'lgani uchun men hayajonlandim.

examples.en: The lesson was boring, so we were bored.
examples.uz: Dars zerikarli edi, shuning uchun biz zerikdik.

examples.en: She is interested in space. Planets are interesting.

mistakes.wrong: I am boring in maths class.
mistakes.right: I am bored in maths class.
mistakes.note_uz: Sizning his-tuyg'ungiz uchun -ed shakli ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: The match was very excited.
mistakes.right: The match was very exciting.
mistakes.note_uz: Narsani tasvirlash uchun -ing shakli ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The cartoon is very ___. Everyone laughs.
I'm ___ in robots. I read about them every day.
The long walk was ___, and we all went to bed early.
My sister was ___ because her team won the match.
It was a ___ story, so I could not sleep.
We were ___ when the magician pulled a rabbit from his hat.

title: comparison review (not as ... as, the more ... the more)
title_uz: Taqqoslash: not as ... as, the more ... the more
rule_uz: Ikki narsa teng bo'lsa as + sifat + as ishlatamiz: as tall as. Teng bo'lmasa not as + sifat + as deymiz: This bag is not as heavy as that one, ya'ni bu sumka u sumkadan yengilroq. Ikkinchi darajali taqqoslashda sifat + er yoki more + sifat, than bilan keladi. The more ... the more tuzilmasi bir o'zgarish ikkinchisini keltirib chiqarishini bildiradi: The more you practise, the better you play.

examples.en: My phone is not as new as yours.
examples.uz: Mening telefonim seniki kabi yangi emas.

examples.en: The more I read, the more I learn.
examples.uz: Qancha ko'p o'qisam, shuncha ko'p o'rganaman.

examples.en: Football is more popular than chess in my class.

mistakes.wrong: He is not as taller as me.
mistakes.right: He is not as tall as me.
mistakes.note_uz: As ... as orasida sifatning oddiy shakli turadi.

mistakes.wrong: The more you practise, the good you play.
mistakes.right: The more you practise, the better you play.
mistakes.note_uz: Ikkala qismda ham qiyosiy daraja kerak.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: My sister is as ___ as my mother now.
This test was not as ___ as the last one.
Cats are ___ independent than dogs.
The more you eat, the ___ you feel.
The harder we train, the ___ we play.
Mars is not as ___ to the sun as Earth is.

title: adverbs of degree (very, quite, fairly, extremely)
rule_uz: Adverbs of degree sifat yoki ravishning qanchalik kuchli ekanini bildiradi. Ular sifatdan oldin turadi. Kuchlilik tartibi: a bit / fairly / quite - o'rtacha, very - kuchli, extremely - juda kuchli. Too "keraklidan ortiq" degani va salbiy ma'no beradi: too hot. Enough sifatdan keyin keladi: big enough. Absolute sifatlar (freezing, huge) bilan very emas, absolutely yoki really ishlatiladi.

examples.en: The test was fairly easy.
It is extremely cold in January here.
This box is too heavy for me.
examples.uz: Bu quti men uchun juda og'ir.

mistakes.wrong: The room is enough big.
mistakes.right: The room is big enough.
mistakes.note_uz: Enough sifatdan keyin keladi.

mistakes.wrong: I am very exhausted.
mistakes.right: I am absolutely exhausted.
mistakes.note_uz: Exhausted kuchli sifat, uning oldida very ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The soup is ___ hot. I can't eat it yet.
He is only ten, so he is not old ___ to drive.
It's ___ cold today. I need a jacket, but not a coat.
The suitcase is ___ heavy. I can't lift it at all.
I am ___ tired, so I want to sleep right now.
That film was ___ good. I'd see it again.

title: word order in questions; subject and object questions
title_uz: Savol tartibi; ega va to'ldiruvchiga savollar
rule_uz: Oddiy savolda tartib: so'roq so'z + yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l: Where do you live? Ega haqida so'raganda (who, what) yordamchi fe'l kerak emas va tartib darak gapdagidek: Who broke the window? To'ldiruvchi haqida so'raganda esa yordamchi fe'l kerak: Who did you meet? Present Simple va Past Simple da do, does, did ishlatiladi, shundan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda qoladi.
forms: Object question: Who + did + subject + verb

examples.en: Where does your cousin live?
Who made this cake?
What did you buy at the market?

mistakes.wrong: Where you did go yesterday?
mistakes.right: Where did you go yesterday?
mistakes.note_uz: Yordamchi fe'l egadan oldin keladi.

mistakes.wrong: Who did break the vase?
mistakes.right: Who broke the vase?
mistakes.note_uz: Ega haqidagi savolda did kerak emas.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Where ___ your brother study?
What time ___ the film start?
Who ___ the last piece of cake? I can't see it!

title: indirect questions (Could you tell me where ...?)
rule_uz: Kimdandir muloyim tarzda ma'lumot so'rash uchun Could you tell me ... ? yoki Do you know ... ? kabi iboralardan keyin savolni joylashtiramiz. Ichki savolda tartib darak gapdagidek bo'ladi: ega fe'ldan oldin, do/does/did ishlatilmaydi. Savol belgisi faqat oxirida bitta: Could you tell me where the library is? Ha/yo'q savollarida if yoki whether qo'shiladi.
forms: Could you tell me + wh-word + subject + verb?
Do you know where he lives?
Can you tell me if the bus is late?
no do / does / did in the second part

examples.en: Could you tell me where the bus stop is?
Do you know what time the shop opens?
I wonder if she likes this song.

mistakes.wrong: Could you tell me where is the station?
mistakes.right: Could you tell me where the station is?
mistakes.note_uz: Ichki savolda tartib oddiy: where + ega + fe'l.

mistakes.wrong: Do you know what does he want?
mistakes.right: Do you know what he wants?
mistakes.note_uz: Ichki savolda does ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Excuse me, could you tell me where the toilet ___?
Do you know what time the lesson ___?

title: question tags
rule_uz: Question tag gap oxiridagi qisqa savol bo'lib, fikrni tasdiqlatish yoki tekshirish uchun ishlatiladi. Darak gapdan keyin inkor tag, inkor gapdan keyin darak tag keladi: You like tea, don't you? He isn't here, is he? Tag asosiy gapdagi yordamchi fe'lni takrorlaydi. Yordamchi fe'l bo'lmasa do/does/did ishlatiladi. I am dan keyin aren't I deymiz. Let's dan keyin shall we, buyruqdan keyin will you bo'ladi.

examples.en: It's a nice day, isn't it?
You didn't forget your book, did you?
Your brother plays the guitar, doesn't he?

mistakes.wrong: She is your sister, is she?
mistakes.right: She is your sister, isn't she?
mistakes.note_uz: Darak gapdan keyin inkor tag keladi.

mistakes.wrong: They don't live here, don't they?
mistakes.right: They don't live here, do they?
mistakes.note_uz: Inkor gapdan keyin darak tag keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: You are a student, ___?
Ali likes pizza, ___?
They didn't come to school, ___?
She can't swim, ___?
I am right, ___?
Let's play outside, ___?

title: so do I / neither do I; too / either
title_uz: So do I / neither do I; too / either
rule_uz: Boshqa odamning gapiga qo'shilganda qisqa javob beramiz. Darak gapga: So + yordamchi fe'l + ega: I like pizza. - So do I. Inkor gapga: Neither + yordamchi fe'l + ega: I don't like fish. - Neither do I. Yordamchi fe'l birinchi gapdagi bilan mos bo'ladi: am - am, can - can, did - did. Too darak gap oxirida, either inkor gap oxirida keladi: I like it too. I don't like it either.
forms: So + do / am / can / did + I
Neither + do / am / can / did + I

examples.en: I love animals. - So do I.
examples.uz: Men hayvonlarni yaxshi ko'raman. - Men ham.

examples.en: She can't swim. - Neither can I.
I'm not hungry, and he isn't either.
examples.uz: Men och emasman, u ham och emas.

mistakes.wrong: I don't like cold milk. - So do I.
mistakes.right: I don't like cold milk. - Neither do I.
mistakes.note_uz: Inkor gapga javobda neither ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I can't swim and she can't too.
mistakes.right: I can't swim and she can't either.
mistakes.note_uz: Inkor gapda too emas, either ishlatiladi.

title: phrasal verbs 1 (separable)
rule_uz: Phrasal verb fe'l + qo'shimcha so'zdan iborat bo'lib, yangi ma'no beradi: turn on, pick up, put away. Ajraladigan phrasal verb to'ldiruvchisi ikki o'rinda turishi mumkin: turn off the light yoki turn the light off. Agar to'ldiruvchi olmosh bo'lsa (it, them, me), u faqat o'rtada turadi: turn it off, ya'ni turn off it deb bo'lmaydi.
forms: turn on / off, pick up, put away, throw away
verb + noun + particle: pick the book up
verb + pronoun + particle: pick it up

examples.en: Please turn off the TV before bed.
She picked her bag up and left.
I threw them away because they were old.
examples.uz: Ular eski bo'lgani uchun tashlab yubordim.

mistakes.wrong: Turn off it, please.
mistakes.right: Turn it off, please.
mistakes.note_uz: Olmosh phrasal verb o'rtasida turadi.

mistakes.wrong: I picked up it from the floor.
mistakes.right: I picked it up from the floor.
mistakes.note_uz: It, them, me kabi olmoshlar fe'l bilan zarracha orasiga qo'yiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: It's dark. Please ___ the light.

title: phrasal verbs 2 (inseparable)
rule_uz: Ba'zi phrasal verblar ajralmaydi: to'ldiruvchi har doim zarrachadan keyin keladi. Masalan: look after (qarash, g'amxo'rlik qilish), get on with (til topishmoq), run out of (tugab qolmoq), look forward to (intizorlik bilan kutmoq), come across (tasodifan uchratmoq). Olmosh ham zarrachadan keyin keladi: look after them, ya'ni look them after emas. Look forward to dan keyin -ing shakli keladi.
forms: get on with / run out of + object

examples.en: I look after my little brother in the afternoon.
We ran out of milk this morning.
I'm looking forward to seeing my cousins.

mistakes.wrong: She looks them after every day.
mistakes.right: She looks after them every day.
mistakes.note_uz: Ajralmaydigan phrasal verbda olmosh oxirida turadi.

mistakes.wrong: I look forward to see you.
mistakes.right: I look forward to seeing you.
mistakes.note_uz: Look forward to dan keyin -ing shakli keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Can you ___ my cat while I'm away?

title: prepositions after adjectives (afraid of, good at)
rule_uz: Ko'p sifatlar o'zidan keyin aniq bir predlog talab qiladi, ularni birga yodlash kerak: afraid of, good at, interested in, proud of, angry with, worried about, different from, ready for. Predlogdan keyin ot, olmosh yoki -ing shakli keladi: good at swimming. To + fe'l kelmaydi: afraid of flying, afraid to fly emas (bu ham bor, lekin ma'no biroz boshqa).
forms: afraid of, proud of, scared of

examples.en: My little sister is afraid of the dark.
Aziz is very good at maths.
We are proud of our team.

mistakes.wrong: I'm interested on robots.
mistakes.right: I'm interested in robots.
mistakes.note_uz: Interested bilan in predlogi ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: She is good in drawing.
mistakes.right: She is good at drawing.
mistakes.note_uz: Good bilan at ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: My brother is afraid ___ spiders.
She is very good ___ playing the piano.

title: prepositions after verbs (listen to, wait for)
rule_uz: Ba'zi fe'llar aniq bir predlog bilan ishlatiladi: listen to, wait for, look at, talk to, ask for, depend on, belong to, think about, laugh at, arrive at/in. O'zbek tilida bu fe'llar predlogsiz kelishi mumkin, shuning uchun inglizchada predlogni tushirib qoldirmaslik kerak: I listen to music. Predlogdan keyin olmosh bo'lsa, u to'ldiruvchi shaklida keladi: wait for me, listen to him.
forms: listen to, talk to, belong to
wait for, ask for, look for
look at, laugh at, think about

examples.en: We are waiting for the bus.
Please listen to your teacher.
The children laughed at the funny clown.

mistakes.wrong: I'm waiting the bus.
mistakes.right: I'm waiting for the bus.
mistakes.note_uz: Wait fe'lidan keyin for kerak.

mistakes.wrong: She listens music every day.
mistakes.right: She listens to music every day.
mistakes.note_uz: Listen dan keyin to kerak.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Please listen ___ me carefully.
We are waiting ___ the train.

title: prepositions of movement
rule_uz: Harakat yo'nalishini ko'rsatish uchun predloglar ishlatiladi. To - biror joyga: go to school. Into - ichiga, out of - ichidan tashqariga. Across - bir tomondan ikkinchi tomonga (yuzasi bo'ylab), through - ichidan o'tib, along - bo'ylab. Up - yuqoriga, down - pastga. Over - ustidan oshib, past - yonidan o'tib. Round/around - atrofida aylanib, towards - tomon.

examples.en: The cat jumped over the fence.
We walked through the forest to the lake.
The bus drove past our school.

mistakes.wrong: She went in the room slowly.
mistakes.right: She went into the room slowly.
mistakes.note_uz: Harakat bilan ichiga kirish uchun into ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: He ran through the road.
mistakes.right: He ran across the road.
mistakes.note_uz: Yo'lning bir tomonidan ikkinchisiga o'tish uchun across.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The boy ran ___ the room and shut the door.

title: contrast: although, however, despite
rule_uz: Although, however va despite ikki fikr bir-biriga zid bo'lganda ishlatiladi. Although bilan to'liq gap keladi: Although it was cold, we played outside. Despite dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi: Despite the rain, we went out. However yangi gap boshida keladi va undan keyin vergul qo'yiladi: It was cold. However, we played outside. Despite dan keyin of kelmaydi va gap (ega + fe'l) kelmaydi.
forms: Despite the fact that + subject + verb

examples.en: Although he was tired, he finished his homework.
examples.uz: U charchagan bo'lsa ham, uy vazifasini tugatdi.

examples.en: Despite the rain, we played football.
The test was difficult. However, most students passed.
examples.uz: Test qiyin edi. Biroq, ko'pchilik o'quvchilar o'tdi.

mistakes.wrong: Despite he was ill, he came to school.
mistakes.right: Although he was ill, he came to school.
mistakes.note_uz: Despite dan keyin to'liq gap kelmaydi, although ishlating.

mistakes.wrong: Despite of the noise, I slept well.
mistakes.right: Despite the noise, I slept well.
mistakes.note_uz: Despite bilan of ishlatilmaydi.

title: reason and result: because, so, therefore, as
title_uz: Sabab va natija: because, so, therefore, as
rule_uz: Because va as sababni bildiradi: I stayed home because I was ill. So va therefore natijani bildiradi: I was ill, so I stayed home. Because dan keyin sabab, so dan keyin natija keladi. Therefore odatda yangi gap boshida keladi va undan keyin vergul qo'yiladi. As gap boshida ham kelishi mumkin: As it was late, we went home.

examples.en: I took an umbrella because it was raining.
examples.uz: Yomg'ir yog'ayotgani uchun men soyabon oldim.

examples.en: It was very hot, so we bought ice cream.
examples.uz: Juda issiq edi, shuning uchun biz muzqaymoq sotib oldik.

examples.en: As I was hungry, I made a sandwich.
examples.uz: Qornim och bo'lgani uchun men buterbrod tayyorladim.

mistakes.wrong: I was tired, because I went to bed early.
mistakes.right: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
mistakes.note_uz: Natija oldidan so ishlatiladi, because emas.

mistakes.wrong: Because it was late, so we left.
mistakes.right: Because it was late, we left.
mistakes.note_uz: Because va so bir gapda birga ishlatilmaydi.

title: purpose: to, in order to, so that
title_uz: Maqsad: to, in order to, so that
rule_uz: Nima uchun biror ish qilganimizni aytish uchun maqsad bildiruvchi qurilmalar ishlatiladi. To va in order to dan keyin fe'lning oddiy shakli keladi: I use an app to learn English. So that dan keyin to'liq gap keladi, ko'pincha can, could yoki will bilan: I speak slowly so that everyone can understand. Inkorda in order not to ishlatiladi. For dan keyin fe'l -ing shaklida kelmaydi, maqsad uchun to ishlating.
forms: I use it + in order to + verb
I speak slowly + so that + subject + can / could

examples.en: He went to the shop to buy some milk.
examples.uz: U sut sotib olish uchun do'konga bordi.

examples.en: She got up early in order to catch the first bus.
examples.uz: U birinchi avtobusga ulgurish uchun erta turdi.

examples.en: I wrote the date down so that I wouldn't forget it.
examples.uz: Unutmaslik uchun men sanani yozib qo'ydim.

mistakes.wrong: I went to the library for borrow a book.
mistakes.right: I went to the library to borrow a book.
mistakes.note_uz: Maqsad uchun to + fe'l ishlatiladi, for + fe'l emas.

mistakes.wrong: He ran in order to not be late.
mistakes.right: He ran in order not to be late.
mistakes.note_uz: Inkor: in order not to.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I went to the shop ___ buy some bread.

title: time linkers: while, during, until, by the time
title_uz: Vaqt bog'lovchilari: while, during, until, by the time
rule_uz: While dan keyin to'liq gap keladi va u bir ish davom etayotgan paytni bildiradi: While I was cooking, he called. During dan keyin ot keladi: during the lesson, during the holidays. Until biror ish to'xtaguncha degan ma'noni beradi: Wait until I come. By the time esa biror vaqtgacha ish allaqachon bajarilganini bildiradi: By the time we arrived, the film had started.
forms: By the time + subject + verb, ... had + past participle

examples.en: I read a book while I was waiting for the bus.
He fell asleep during the film.
By the time we got to the station, the train had left.
examples.uz: Biz bekatga yetib borguncha poyezd ketib bo'lgan edi.

mistakes.wrong: I fell asleep while the lesson.
mistakes.right: I fell asleep during the lesson.
mistakes.note_uz: While dan keyin gap, during dan keyin ot keladi.

mistakes.wrong: Wait here until will come my mother.
mistakes.right: Wait here until my mother comes.
mistakes.note_uz: Until dan keyin kelasi zamon emas, hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi.

title: time adverbs: since, for, ago, already, yet, still
title_uz: Vaqt ravishlari: since, for, ago, already, yet, still
rule_uz: For davomiylikni bildiradi (for two years), since esa boshlanish vaqtini (since 2020). Ikkalasi ham Present Perfect bilan ishlatiladi. Ago o'tgan zamon bilan keladi: two days ago. Already va just gap o'rtasida, yet esa so'roq va inkor gaplar oxirida keladi: Have you finished yet? Still ish hali davom etayotganini bildiradi va odatda fe'ldan oldin keladi: He still lives here.
forms: have lived here + for five years
I saw him + two days ago (past simple)
have already / haven't ... yet / still + verb

examples.en: We have known each other for three years.
examples.uz: Biz bir-birimizni uch yildan beri bilamiz.

examples.en: I haven't finished my project yet.
She moved to London two years ago.
examples.uz: U ikki yil oldin Londonga ko'chib o'tdi.

mistakes.wrong: I have lived here since five years.
mistakes.right: I have lived here for five years.
mistakes.note_uz: Muddat oldidan for, boshlanish nuqtasi oldidan since ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I have seen him two days ago.
mistakes.right: I saw him two days ago.
mistakes.note_uz: Ago bilan Past Simple ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I have studied English ___ four years.

title: wish + past simple
rule_uz: Wish bilan hozirgi vaqtdagi istamagan holat haqida afsuslanamiz: I wish I had a dog (lekin menda it yo'q). Wish dan keyin Past Simple ishlatiladi, lekin ma'nosi hozirgi zamonga tegishli. To be fe'li uchun barcha shaxslarda were ishlatish mumkin: I wish I were taller. Kelajakdagi istak uchun I wish you would shaklidan ham foydalaniladi.
forms: I wish + I / you / we / they + had
I wish + he / she / it + lived (Past Simple)
I wish + I were / he were

examples.en: I wish I had a bigger room.
She wishes she lived near the sea.
examples.uz: Qani endi u dengiz yonida yashasa.

examples.en: I wish I could swim faster.

mistakes.wrong: I wish I have a bike.
mistakes.right: I wish I had a bike.
mistakes.note_uz: Wish dan keyin Past Simple ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I wish I am taller.
mistakes.right: I wish I were taller.
mistakes.note_uz: Wish dan keyin am emas, were ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I don't have a pet. I wish I ___ a cat.

title: would rather / prefer
rule_uz: Nimani ko'proq yoqtirishni aytish uchun prefer va would rather ishlatiladi. Prefer dan keyin -ing yoki to + fe'l keladi: I prefer swimming to running. Would rather dan keyin to'siz fe'l keladi: I would rather stay at home. Taqqoslash uchun would rather ... than ishlatiladi: I'd rather walk than take the bus. Inkori: would rather not.

examples.en: I prefer tea to coffee.
I'd rather play chess than watch TV.
examples.uz: Televizor ko'rgandan ko'ra shaxmat o'ynashni afzal ko'raman.

examples.en: Would you prefer to go by train?

mistakes.wrong: I would rather to stay home.
mistakes.right: I would rather stay home.
mistakes.note_uz: Would rather dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: I prefer cycling than walking.
mistakes.right: I prefer cycling to walking.
mistakes.note_uz: Prefer bilan than emas, to ishlatiladi.

title: it as dummy subject; there is / there are in different tenses
title_uz: Sodda ega it; there is / there are turli zamonlarda
rule_uz: Ob-havo, vaqt va masofa haqida gapirganda it ega vazifasida keladi: It is cold. It is five o'clock. There is / there are biror narsa borligini bildiradi. Birlik otlar bilan there is, ko'plik bilan there are ishlatiladi. O'tgan zamonda there was / there were, Present Perfect da there has been / there have been, kelasi zamonda there will be ishlatiladi.
forms: There will be / There has been + noun

examples.en: It was sunny when we arrived.
examples.uz: Biz yetib kelganimizda havo quyoshli edi.

examples.en: There were many people at the concert.
There will be a test next Monday.

mistakes.wrong: Is raining now.
mistakes.right: It is raining now.
mistakes.note_uz: Inglizcha gapda ega bo'lishi shart, shuning uchun it ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: There was two books on the desk.
mistakes.right: There were two books on the desk.
mistakes.note_uz: Ko'plik ot bilan were ishlatiladi.

title: have / get something done
rule_uz: Biror ishni o'zimiz qilmay, boshqa odamga qildirganimizda have something done yoki get something done ishlatiladi. Shakli: have + narsa + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi (Past Participle). Masalan: I had my hair cut (men sochimni oldirdim). Kim qilgani odatda aytilmaydi. Get shakli ko'proq so'zlashuv tilida ishlatiladi.
forms: She has her hair cut every month.
I need to get my bike repaired.

examples.en: We had our house painted last year.
I'm going to get my phone fixed tomorrow.
He has his hair cut every month.

mistakes.wrong: I cut my hair yesterday at the barber's.
mistakes.right: I had my hair cut yesterday.
mistakes.note_uz: Boshqa odam qilgan ishda have + Past Participle ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I had repaired my bike.
mistakes.right: I had my bike repaired.
mistakes.note_uz: Tartib: have + narsa + Past Participle.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I had my bike ___ last week.
She is going to ___ her photo taken.
We ___ our windows cleaned every month.

I need to get my computer ___ before Monday.

title: get + adjective; get used to
rule_uz: Get sifat bilan kelsa, "bo'lmoq, bo'lib qolmoq" ma'nosini beradi: get tired, get cold, get dark. Bu o'zgarish jarayonini bildiradi. Get used to + ot yoki -ing esa biror narsaga o'rganib qolish degan ma'noni beradi: I'm getting used to the new school. Be used to ham shunday: o'rganib qolgan holat.

examples.en: It gets dark early in winter.
I'm getting used to the new school.
She isn't used to waking up early.

mistakes.wrong: I'm getting used to wake up early.
mistakes.right: I'm getting used to waking up early.
mistakes.note_uz: Get used to dan keyin -ing shakli keladi.

mistakes.wrong: He got angrily.
mistakes.right: He got angry.
mistakes.note_uz: Get dan keyin ravish emas, sifat keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: It gets ___ very early in December.
My little sister got ___ after the long walk.

It's getting ___. Let's put on our coats.
I can't get used to ___ my food with chopsticks.

title: make / let / allow
rule_uz: Make biror kishini majburlashni bildiradi: My mum makes me clean my room. Let ruxsat berishni bildiradi: My dad lets me use his laptop. Make va let dan keyin to'siz fe'l keladi. Allow ham ruxsat bildiradi, lekin dan keyin to bilan fe'l keladi: They allow us to use phones. Passivda esa be allowed to ishlatiladi.

examples.en: The teacher made us repeat the words.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi bizni so'zlarni takrorlashga majbur qildi.

examples.en: My parents let me stay up late on Fridays.
examples.uz: Ota-onam juma kunlari kech yotishga ruxsat berishadi.

examples.en: We aren't allowed to eat in class.

mistakes.wrong: My mum made me to clean my room.
mistakes.right: My mum made me clean my room.
mistakes.note_uz: Make dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: He lets me to play games.
mistakes.right: He lets me play games.
mistakes.note_uz: Let dan keyin ham to ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: My mother makes me ___ my bed every day.

title: countable and uncountable nouns; containers (a bottle of, a slice of)
rule_uz: Sanaladigan otlarni sanash mumkin: an apple, two apples. Sanalmaydigan otlarni (water, bread, milk, money, information) sanab bo'lmaydi va ko'plik shaklida ishlatilmaydi. Ularni o'lchash uchun idish va bo'lak so'zlari ishlatiladi: a bottle of water, a slice of bread, a piece of advice. Many sanaladigan otlar bilan, much esa sanalmaydigan otlar bilan keladi. Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan fe'l birlikda bo'ladi.
forms: a / an + singular countable noun; plural -s
uncountable noun: no a / an, no -s
a bottle / carton / glass of + uncountable
a slice / piece / bar of + uncountable

examples.en: I'd like a glass of orange juice, please.
She gave me a useful piece of advice.
How much bread do we need?

mistakes.wrong: I need some informations.
mistakes.right: I need some information.
mistakes.note_uz: Information sanalmaydigan ot, -s olmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: How many water do you drink?
mistakes.right: How much water do you drink?
mistakes.note_uz: Sanalmaydigan ot bilan much ishlatiladi.

title: possessives: 's / of / double possessive
rule_uz: Odamlar va hayvonlarga tegishli narsa uchun 's qo'shamiz: Ali's bag, my sister's room. Ko'plik -s bilan tugasa, faqat apostrof qo'shiladi: the girls' room. Jonsiz narsalar uchun of ishlatiladi: the door of the classroom. Double possessive: a friend of mine, a book of Tom's. Bu bir nechta do'stlardan birini bildiradi.
forms: a friend of mine / a friend of Ali's

examples.en: This is my brother's bicycle.
The windows of our classroom are very big.
She is a friend of mine.

mistakes.wrong: The door of Anvar is open.
mistakes.right: Anvar's door is open.
mistakes.note_uz: Odamga tegishli narsa uchun 's ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: This is a friend of me.
mistakes.right: This is a friend of mine.
mistakes.note_uz: Of dan keyin me emas, mine keladi.

title: defining relative clauses: leaving out the pronoun
title_uz: Aniqlovchi ergash gaplar: olmoshni tushirib qoldirish
rule_uz: Aniqlovchi ergash gapda who, which yoki that ot haqida muhim ma'lumot beradi. Agar olmosh ergash gapdagi ob'ekt bo'lsa, uni tushirib qoldirish mumkin: The book (that) I read was great. Olmosh ega bo'lsa, uni tushirib bo'lmaydi: The girl who lives here is my friend. Tekshirish usuli: olmoshdan keyin ega (I, he, we) kelsa, olmoshni tushirish mumkin.
forms: The film (that) we saw was funny.
The boy (who) I met is nice.
The girl who lives here is nice (olmosh kerak).
who / which / that + verb: tushirib bo'lmaydi

examples.en: The song you like is on the radio.
This is the boy I told you about.
The man who lives next door is a doctor.

mistakes.wrong: The girl lives next door is my friend.
mistakes.right: The girl who lives next door is my friend.
mistakes.note_uz: Olmosh ega bo'lsa, uni tushirib bo'lmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: The book that I read it was great.
mistakes.right: The book that I read was great.
mistakes.note_uz: Ob'ektni qayta takrorlamang: it ortiqcha.

title: mixed review: tenses in a story
rule_uz: Hikoya aytganda bir nechta o'tgan zamon shakllari birga ishlatiladi. Past Simple voqealar ketma-ketligini aytadi: He opened the door and went in. Past Continuous fonda davom etgan ishni bildiradi: It was raining. Past Perfect esa boshqa voqeadan oldin bo'lgan ishni bildiradi: He had forgotten his key. Hozirgi zamon holatlari uchun Present Perfect ishlatiladi.
forms: Past Continuous: fon, davom etgan ish
Past Perfect: oldin bo'lgan ish (had + V3)

examples.en: It was raining when I left the house.
When we arrived, the film had already started.
examples.uz: Biz yetib kelganimizda film allaqachon boshlangan edi.

examples.en: I was walking home when I saw a rainbow.

mistakes.wrong: When I arrived, the lesson already started.
mistakes.right: When I arrived, the lesson had already started.
mistakes.note_uz: Oldin bo'lgan ish uchun Past Perfect kerak.

mistakes.wrong: I walked home when it started to rain.
mistakes.right: I was walking home when it started to rain.
mistakes.note_uz: Davom etayotgan ish uchun Past Continuous ishlating.

title: mixed review: conditionals
rule_uz: Zero conditional umumiy haqiqatlar uchun: If you heat ice, it melts. First conditional kelajakdagi real imkoniyat uchun: If it rains, we will stay home. Second conditional xayoliy yoki noreal vaziyat uchun: If I had a bike, I would ride it to school. If gapida zamon, asosiy gapda esa will yoki would keladi. If dan keyin will yoki would ishlatilmaydi.

examples.en: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
examples.uz: Qizil va ko'kni aralashtirsangiz, binafsha rang chiqadi.

examples.en: If I finish early, I will call you.
examples.uz: Agar erta tugatsam, senga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

examples.en: If I were a bird, I would fly over the mountains.
examples.uz: Agar qush bo'lsam, tog'lar uzra uchardim.

mistakes.wrong: If it will rain, we will stay home.
mistakes.right: If it rains, we will stay home.
mistakes.note_uz: If dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: If I have a dog, I would take it for walks.
mistakes.right: If I had a dog, I would take it for walks.
mistakes.note_uz: Xayoliy vaziyatda if + Past Simple.

title: mixed review: passive and reported speech
title_uz: Aralash takrorlash: majhul nisbat va ko'chirma gap
rule_uz: Majhul nisbat ishni kim qilgani muhim bo'lmaganda ishlatiladi: be + Past Participle. Masalan: English is spoken here. Ko'chirma gapni o'zgartirganda zamon bir qadam orqaga suriladi: "I am tired" - He said he was tired. Savollar if yoki so'roq so'z bilan beriladi va tartib oddiy gapdagidek bo'ladi. Buyruqlar uchun told / asked + kishi + to + fe'l ishlatiladi.

examples.en: This bridge was built in 1990.
Tom said that he was hungry.
The teacher asked us to open our books.

mistakes.wrong: The window was broke by the ball.
mistakes.right: The window was broken by the ball.
mistakes.note_uz: Majhul nisbatda Past Participle (broken) kerak.

mistakes.wrong: She asked me where do I live.
mistakes.right: She asked me where I lived.
mistakes.note_uz: Ko'chirma savolda oddiy tartib ishlatiladi.

title: phrasal verbs 3 (travel)
rule_uz: Frazali fe'l fe'l va predlog yoki ravishdan iborat bo'lib, ma'nosi alohida bo'ladi. Sayohat haqida ko'p ishlatiladi: set off (yo'lga chiqmoq), check in (ro'yxatdan o'tmoq), take off (uchmoq), get on (transportga chiqmoq), get off (tushmoq), look around (aylanib ko'rmoq). Ularni butun ibora sifatida yodlash kerak.
forms: check in / check out = ro'yxatdan o'tmoq / chiqmoq
get on / get off = chiqmoq / tushmoq

examples.en: We set off at six in the morning.
examples.uz: Biz ertalab soat oltida yo'lga chiqdik.

examples.en: The plane took off ten minutes late.
We checked in at the hotel and went to our room.
examples.uz: Biz mehmonxonada ro'yxatdan o'tib, xonamizga bordik.

mistakes.right: The plane took off at nine o'clock.
mistakes.note_uz: Samolyot uchishi take off deyiladi.

mistakes.wrong: We got in the bus at the market.
mistakes.right: We got on the bus at the market.
mistakes.note_uz: Avtobus, poyezd bilan get on ishlatiladi.

title: phrasal verbs 4 (daily life)
rule_uz: Kundalik hayotda ko'p ishlatiladigan frazali fe'llar: wake up (uyg'onmoq), get up (turmoq), put on (kiymoq), take off (yechmoq), turn on / off (yoqmoq / o'chirmoq), clean up (tozalamoq), pick up (olmoq), throw away (tashlamoq). Ko'pchiligida ot fe'l bilan ravish orasiga ham, keyin ham kela oladi. Olmosh bo'lsa, doim orada turadi: turn it off.
forms: turn on / turn off + a device
pick up / throw away / clean up

mistakes.note_uz: Olmosh fe'l va ravish orasida turadi.

title: word formation: suffixes (-er, -tion, -ment)
rule_uz: Qo'shimchalar yordamida fe'ldan ot yasaladi. -er / -or ishni bajaruvchi odamni bildiradi: teach - teacher, act - actor. -tion / -sion harakat yoki natijani bildiradi: decide - decision, inform - information. -ment ham shunday: move - movement, enjoy - enjoyment. Ba'zan imlo biroz o'zgaradi: educate - education.
forms: verb ending in -e: drop e (educate - education)

examples.en: My uncle is a very good driver.
We got an invitation to the party.
The government wants to improve education.

mistakes.wrong: She is a good teach.
mistakes.right: She is a good teacher.
mistakes.note_uz: Odam nomi uchun fe'lga -er qo'shiladi.

mistakes.wrong: This is a great enjoy.
mistakes.right: This is great enjoyment.
mistakes.note_uz: Ot yasash uchun -ment kerak.

title: word formation: prefixes (un-, dis-, im-)
title_uz: So'z yasalishi: old qo'shimchalar (un-, dis-, im-)
rule_uz: Old qo'shimchalar so'z ma'nosini qarama-qarshisiga o'zgartiradi. Un- ko'p sifatlar bilan keladi: happy - unhappy, usual - unusual. Dis- ko'pincha fe'l va otlar bilan: agree - disagree, like - dislike. Im- p yoki m bilan boshlanadigan so'zlar oldida: possible - impossible, polite - impolite. So'zning imlosi o'zgarmaydi, faqat boshiga qo'shimcha qo'shiladi.

examples.en: I was unhappy when I lost my keys.
They disagree about the plan.

examples.uz: Buni besh daqiqada tugatish mumkin emas.

mistakes.right: It is impossible to open this box.
mistakes.note_uz: Possible oldidan im- qo'shiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I undislike spiders.
mistakes.right: I dislike spiders.
mistakes.note_uz: Like ning inkori dislike, un- emas.

title: discourse markers and linking in writing (first, then, finally)
rule_uz: Yozuvda fikrlarni tartib bilan bog'lash uchun bog'lovchi so'zlar ishlatiladi. Tartib uchun: first, then, next, after that, finally. Fikr qo'shish uchun: also, in addition. Qarama-qarshilik uchun: however, but. Natija uchun: so, therefore. Gap boshidagi bog'lovchi so'zdan keyin odatda vergul qo'yiladi: First, mix the eggs.

examples.en: First, wash your hands. Then, cut the vegetables.
examples.uz: Avval qo'llaringizni yuving. Keyin sabzavotlarni to'g'rang.

examples.en: I like football. In addition, I enjoy swimming.
examples.uz: Men futbolni yoqtiraman. Bundan tashqari, suzishni ham yaxshi ko'raman.

examples.en: Finally, we reached the top of the hill.

mistakes.wrong: Finally, then, first I went to the shop.
mistakes.right: First, I went to the shop. Then, I came home.
mistakes.note_uz: Tartib to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak: first - then - finally.

mistakes.wrong: It rained. Therefore, but we went out.
mistakes.right: It rained. However, we went out.
mistakes.note_uz: Qarama-qarshilik uchun however kerak.
